Niko Storment Fuses Country & Pop Punk in Quest for his Earth Girl

  • by Rock the Pigeon
  • Posted on September 14, 2026
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:24
Instaread

On his electrifying new single “Earth Girl,” Niko Storment pulls off a brilliant cosmic balancing act that meshes country and pop punk. He opens with fuzzed-out electric guitars and a rogue synthesizer that instantly launch you into outer space before grounding you with intimate vocals and picked electric guitar. The fusion of genres was unexpected but it works super well. Storment has penned massive, movie-soundtrack choruses where he truly lets loose and belts with powerhouse emotion, showcasing his full vocal abilities. Beneath the soaring melodies and walls of distorted power chords lies a deeply relatable anthem about searching for a centered, grounded love to act as your anchor in a chaotic universe. Driven by a constant push-and-pull between stripped-back introspection and explosive, heavy-drum eruptions, “Earth Girl” is an endlessly catchy, dynamic ride from start to finish. Tune in now:
